Ipsos Political Monitor
Fieldwork: 25-30 June 2026
Published: 3 July 2026
Sample: 1,045 British adults aged 18+

VOTING INTENTION:
- Reform UK 26% (-1 on May)
- Labour 24% (+4)
- Conservatives 18% (-1)
- Green Party 13% (-1)
- Liberal Democrats 11% (-1)

PREFERRED PRIME MINISTER:
- Andy Burnham 30%
- Nigel Farage 16%
- Kemi Badenoch 13%

STARMER SATISFACTION:
- Satisfied 17%
- Dissatisfied 76%
- Net -59

NAMED QUOTE:
Keiran Pedley, Director of Politics at Ipsos:
"Labour will be more optimistic about the future than they were a month ago. However, the
jury is out with the public on whether Burnham himself is ready to be Prime Minister and
whether a Burnham government will deliver in office."

NOTE: This is the poll already used in the MORNING edition. It is NOT a new Saturday poll.
